parsed.note: This is a plain learning-rate sweep (0.035 vs 0.04, next 0.0375) that only changes training hyperparameters; the eval block (EVAL_SPLIT, EVAL_TOKENS, EVAL_SHARD 10) is untouched and TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' still excludes the eval shard, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
